examples.text: Der Soldat nahm im Schützenloch Zuflucht.
examples.en: The soldier took shelter in the foxhole.
Thousands of people took refuge in shelters.

examples.text: In Toms hektischem Geschäftsführerdasein war ihm seine abgeschiedene Waldhütte eine Zuflucht.
examples.en: Tom used his secluded cabin in the woods as a getaway from his hectic life as a company director.
